character_facts: Aghora survives by leaving the universe rather than remaining in the confrontation.
The Metabaron or Metabaron-aligned figure acts according to an uncompromising martial code.
An unidentified speaker argues from a broader moral concern, warning about the lives of countless beings.
characters_present: An unidentified dark circular presence or entity in space
continuity_links: This page appears to conclude a larger battle with Aghora.
The invading jellyfish are tied to Aghora's presence or to the open gateway.
The outcome suggests the immediate threat ends once the gateway is shut.
dialogue_meaning: A surrender is offered, but mercy is refused.
One speaker warns that sparing the defeated being would lead to mass death.
The Metabaron code is presented as absolute: only victory or death, not clemency.
The narration explains that closing the gateway severs the invaders from the power sustaining them.
locations: A cosmic gateway or portal between universes
lore_facts: The Metabarons are said to follow a strict law centered on victory or death.
Aghora is capable of leaving an entire universe through a gateway.
The gateway's closure permanently cuts passage between realms in this moment.
The invading jellyfish depend on an external energy source connected to that gateway.
When cut off from that energy source, the jellyfish dissolve.
plot_events: One participant in the confrontation offers surrender.
Another voice rejects that surrender and argues that accepting it would doom vast numbers of beings.
A warrior aligned with the Metabarons' law declares that defeat requires destruction rather than mercy.
A cosmic energy point or gateway intensifies into a blinding detonation.
As the gateway closes, the invading jellyfish lose their energy source and dissolve.
uncertainties: Some dialogue is small and partially hard to read, so exact wording may be off.
The identity of the close-up cybernetic face is not explicitly confirmed on this page alone.
The dark circular figure in space may represent a being, portal aspect, or visual symbol; the page does not make that fully explicit.
visual_summary: A cosmic confrontation resolves across a two-page spread. A dark circular presence hangs in space while speech balloons announce surrender, reject mercy, and invoke the Metabarons' code. A furious, cybernetic-looking face appears in close-up, then a smaller armored figure is shown amid blinding energy. A glowing sphere or gateway erupts into white light and jagged blue-white energy, ending with a caption that says Aghora leaves the universe and the invading jellyfish dissolve.
